taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-02, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 31374.7 | 20.07 | 20.07
2 | 7559.9 | 12.79 | 32.86
3 | 3573.3 | 1.62 | 34.48
4 | 313.2 | 38.90 | 73.38
5 | 53.6 | 0.41 | 73.79
6 | 22.8 | - | -

What is the curve type of this station? Give a short answer, then end with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type": "<letters>"}

The resistivities of the layers are:
- Layer 1: 31374.7 ohm-m
- Layer 2: 7559.9 ohm-m
- Layer 3: 3573.3 ohm-m
- Layer 4: 313.2 ohm-m
- Layer 5: 53.6 ohm-m
- Layer 6: 22.8 ohm-m

To find the curve-type notation, we analyze every group of three consecutive layers:
1. Layers 1-2-3: 31374.7 > 7559.9 > 3573.3 (r1 > r2 > r3), which corresponds to **Q**.
2. Layers 2-3-4: 7559.9 > 3573.3 > 313.2 (r2 > r3 > r4), which corresponds to **Q**.
3. Layers 3-4-5: 3573.3 > 313.2 > 53.6 (r3 > r4 > r5), which corresponds to **Q**.
4. Layers 4-5-6: 313.2 > 53.6 > 22.8 (r4 > r5 > r6), which corresponds to **Q**.

The sequence of letters is QQQQ. According to the rule, if all the letters are the same, the curve may be written as that single letter.

{"curve_type": "Q"}
